annotation.title_clean: Rozporządzenie Ministra Infrastruktury z dnia 17 października 2018 r. w sprawie wzoru sprawozdania z prac badawczych związanych z testowaniem pojazdów autonomicznych oraz ich wyposażenia
annotation.title_en: Regulation of the Minister of Infrastructure of 17 October 2018 on the template of the report on research work related to the testing of autonomous vehicles and their equipment
named_instruments_referenced: Polish Road Traffic Act (Prawo o ruchu drogowym)
annotation.summary_en: Polish Journal of Laws entry page for a 2018 Minister of Infrastructure regulation setting the mandatory template for reports on research work involving the testing of autonomous vehicles and their equipment on public roads. The page shows only metadata (date, position, download link); the template text itself is not included.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the template for reports on research testing of autonomous vehicles and their equipment
Issued by the Minister of Infrastructure on 17 October 2018, published 22 October 2018 (Dz.U. 2018 poz. 2023)
Implements the reporting obligation for entities testing autonomous vehicles under the Polish road traffic framework
